targets.query: from(bucket:"k6") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._measurement=="http_reqs") |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: count, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name:"count")

from(bucket:"k6") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._measurement=="track_activity_latency") |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._field=="p(95)") |> aggregateWindow(every:5s, fn:mean, createEmpty:false) |> yield(name:"p95")
